capabilities_done: Spectrogram (src/spectrogram.rs): STFT magnitude grid with periodic Hann N (power of two 256..16384) and hop 1..N, frame k centred on k*hop, ceil(len/hop) frames x (N/2+1) bins, calibrated so a bin-centred sine of amplitude A reads A (measured within 1e-6; Hann neighbours A/2; DC calibrated); tiles over frame ranges from caller chunks that cover tile_input_range only (streaming big files), bit-identical to the whole grid for 3 parameter sets and mixed tile sizes; memory budget MAX_TILE_CELLS = 2^24 cells per tile checked before work, scratch allocated once, tiles allocate nothing; tile_reassigned adds Auger-Flandrin reassigned time and frequency per cell (measured: a 1000.3 Hz tone reassigns within 0.0031 Hz of its frequency, bin width 23.4 Hz; an impulse reassigns to its exact sample over 4076 cells)

spectral_edit (src/spectral_edit.rs): SpectralSelection (samples start..end x low..high Hz) on a Hann STFT (hop N/4, synthesis w/1.5); only the change of selected cells is resynthesised and added, so every sample outside SpectralEditReport.affected_start..affected_end is the input bit for bit (tested for attenuate and heal); Attenuate (-120..0 dB): full-band selection gives g*x within 2.98e-9 in the interior, a 4-8 kHz band at -20 dB measures -20.000 dB inside and 0.0000 dB below/above; Heal: selected log magnitudes interpolated between the frames three hops outside the selection, phase kept: a 4.2/4.6 kHz burst is reduced by 44.2 dB against the clean signal, the 1 kHz tone outside the band changes by 9e-11; out-of-band 500 Hz content in the edit difference <= 6e-10

StreamingStretch (src/stretch.rs): push/pull streaming phase vocoder on a frame engine shared with time_stretch (offline refactored onto it), bounded preallocated input/output rings (push takes only what fits; tested: a 1 M-sample push takes < 100 k), finish() ends the output at exactly round(total*factor); with transients off bit-identical to time_stretch for push/pull partitions 1/7, 333/4096, 4096/1 and whole at factors 0.6/1.5/3; transient preservation: positive spectral flux > 0.3 = onset, synthesis phase reset to analysis phase, next 4 frames advance the input by exactly H_s (one-to-one resynthesis until the window passes the onset), then the analysis position returns to its target by at most twice the nominal hop; click train (19 clicks every 4800, factor 1.5): energy within +-32 samples of each output click 1.0000 with phase reset vs 0.1107 plain, worst position shift 491 samples (<= 1024 asserted), one onset per click (20 incl. the stream start); a steady faded tone has only the start onset and keeps its amplitude within 0.2 dB; last_onset() diagnostic
